messages.text:
Hello support,

I was charged ₹1,499 twice for my monthly premium plan on September 15th. 😡 Please issue a refund immediately.

Sent from my iPhone
Dear customer, we apologize for the inconvenience. We have verified the duplicate charge and initiated a refund of ₹1,499 to your original payment method. Best regards, Support Team
Thank you so much for the quick resolution! 🙏

Help! I cannot access my dashboard. When I enter my email it says “Account locked due to multiple invalid attempts”.

> Previous ticket #8941 closed without fix.
Hello, we have unlocked your account and sent a password reset link to your registered email address.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: billing-alerts@store.com
Date: Mon, Sep 14, 2026 at 10:00 AM
Subject: Invoice #44812

I need a revised VAT invoice for my business with tax ID €820.00 inclusive of VAT. Thanks!
I placed order #ORD-9921 three days ago, but the tracking page still says 'Pending shipment'. Can you check the status? 📦
Hi there! Your order is currently being packed in our warehouse and will ship by 5 PM today.
Bonjour, mon colis n'est pas encore arrivé. Le numéro de suivi indique qu'il est bloqué au centre de tri. Merci de vérifier.
Bonjour, nous avons contacté le transporteur pour débloquer votre colis. Vous recevrez une mise à jour sous 24h.
Bug report: The API endpoint /v1/telemetry is returning 502 Bad Gateway intermittently when payload size exceeds 2MB.
Thanks for reporting this. Our engineering team deployed a fix for the reverse proxy buffer limits.

How do I update my credit card details on file? The settings button is greyed out.
\n---\nSent from my Samsung Galaxy device
नमस्ते, मुझे अपना ऑर्डर कैंसिल करना है और रिफंड चाहिए। कृपया सहायता करें।

Good morning,
We need to upgrade our enterprise tier from 50 seats to 100 seats. Could an account manager contact us with pricing? $5,000 budget approved.
Best regards, Michael Chang Director of IT
Hello Michael, our enterprise team lead has been assigned and will schedule a call with you this afternoon.
Can someone explain this $15.00 international transaction fee on my receipt? I thought local billing was supported.
